- **Spec:** docs/tickets/P12.1__usage-analytics.md (cites canonical §11.16, §18)

- **Feature branch:** devin/p12-1-usage-analytics

## Key context (Phase 0.3)
- UsageAggregate entity ALREADY exists (ontology entities.yaml:483; generated SQL "UsageAggregate").
- Ingestion bright-line gate ALREADY exists: connectors.audit_structural (aggregate_search_events, assert_no_per_row_output, forbidden_output_columns).
- Bright-line schema tests ALREADY exist: tests/ontology/test_schema_structure.py::test_no_plate_trip_or_per_person_slot_exists; tests/db/test_schema_integrity.py::test_no_plate_capable_column_anywhere (needs docker PG).
- ADR-043 (P11.2) explicitly hands THIS ticket the substrate: "Hive-partitioned Parquet on DuckDB, small-cell suppression, the UUID+period join." RISK-P11-13/14/15 are the scaffolded handoffs.
- duckdb is in the lockfile (direct dep of resolution). evidence is a leaf pkg (blake3, boto3) → db→evidence is safe (no cycle). Only import boundary: nothing outside orchestration imports orchestrators.
- Package style: db/ has flat modules (temporal.py, absence.py, edtf.py, invariants.py), StrEnum + frozen dataclasses, heavy spec-cited docstrings. CLI skeleton in db/cli.py.
- evidence.digest.multihash(bytes, algo="sha2-512") → base32 multibase multihash (SIG-EVID-002). IngestRun dataclass in evidence.ingest_run.

## Deliverables → design
Substrate lives in `db/` (second storage engine). New modules:
- db/src/db/suppression.py — SIG-STORE-030/031/032/033 small-cell suppression (pure).
- db/src/db/analytics.py — SIG-STORE-027 (Parquet/DuckDB substrate, Hive partitions), SIG-STORE-028 (UUID+period join, ingest_run_id + agg_ruleset_version), SIG-STORE-029 (partition-as-evidence + summary claim), SIG-STORE-025/026 (analytics-store bright line: schema has no name/plate column).
- db/pyproject.toml: add duckdb>=1.0.0 + sig-evidence deps.
- db/cli.py: real subcommands.

## Requirements checklist (Phase 0.3)
- [ ] SIG-ONTO-037 — no per-search/plate/person row in UsageAggregate or anywhere (entity already; analytics store must comply too)
- [ ] SIG-STORE-025 — no raw per-search/plate row in canonical OR analytics store
- [ ] SIG-STORE-026 — claim/analytics schema has NO plate-capable column (schema test)
- [ ] SIG-STORE-027 — high-volume aggregates as Hive-partitioned Parquet queried by DuckDB; no columnar PG extension
- [ ] SIG-STORE-028 — partitions join graph ONLY via sig_entity_id UUID + period, never names; carry ingest_run_id + agg_ruleset_version
- [ ] SIG-STORE-029 — partitions registered as evidence artifacts w/ digests; summary claim cites the partition
- [ ] SIG-STORE-030 — counts 1-4 suppressed (null + suppressed_flag + k_threshold, never zero); complementary suppression; one-month min granularity
- [ ] SIG-STORE-031 — suppression records which rationale applied; institutional small counts not suppressed for being small
- [ ] SIG-STORE-032 — institutional_conduct publishes; protects_individual suppresses; default-when-ambiguous = suppress + raise review task
- [ ] SIG-STORE-033 — k=5 is SIG's own documented policy; stricter partner threshold wins

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 no per-search/per-plate row anywhere (schema test, incl. analytics store; no plate column)
- [ ] AC2 small-cell suppression w/ correct rationale; institutional publishes
- [ ] AC3 analytics joins by UUID+period only, never name
- [ ] AC4 partitions registered as evidence artifacts (digests); summary claims cite them
- [ ] AC5 phase-gate: CI green + data-quality; tests for new reqs; ADR for deviations; traceability + risk-register updated

## Cross-cutting invariants
- Append-only/provenance; raw_value preserved; no writable current-value cols.
- Additive/back-compat: don't break prior wire names/IDs (UsageAggregate row shape from audit_structural).
- Part VIII binding: no plate/trip/per-person storage or lookup.

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)
suppression: k threshold boundary (4 suppress / 5 publish); institutional_conduct small publishes; protects_individual small suppresses→null+flag+k, never zero; contractual suppresses w/ rights cite; ambiguous→suppress+review task; complementary suppression (single suppressed cell → second suppressed so total not invertible); period granularity finer-than-month rejected.
analytics: write Hive-partitioned parquet + read back via duckdb (round-trip); partition path is key=value hive; schema has no name/plate col (bright line); join builder accepts only uuid+period keys and rejects name keys; join carries ingest_run_id + agg_ruleset_version; partition-as-evidence: digest is a multihash, evidence_artifact row + summary claim row cite the digest; suppression applied before partition write (no small raw count leaks).
schema: extend analytics bright-line assertions.
